headline: Direhowl early mount
title: Direhowl | A Fast Early Mount | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a mount early in Palworld one point zero? Direhowl is a small Neutral Pal, and its partner skill, Direhowl Rider, lets you ride it and move slightly faster than most mounts. It is a simple pick for your first ride. At your base it only has Gathering level one, so use it as transport for you, not as a worker. Will you ride one first? Comment below!
description: Direhowl in Palworld 1.0 is a small Neutral Pal you can ride, with Gathering level one.
